div vs span
Product card · div: product container · Product: Book · Price: Rs. 500 span
Read the diagram step by step

The div groups the whole product card. The span surrounds only the inline price text for
styling or scripting. Neither adds specific semantic meaning.
div එJකෙන් content group එකෙකේ හදෙනවා. span එJකෙන් text එJකේ Jකොටසකේ J+තෝරනවා. Meaningful tag එකෙකේ තිJයෙනවා නම් ඒකෙ භාවි+ කෙරන්න.
